column3: Description
Body_Base_v2.stl. The housing with the grip built in; holds the two rollers upright and side by side. Arrows on its right-hand side mark the card's direction and which way up.
Body_Top_v2.stl. Snaps onto the Base; its post is the top axle of Roller B and its large hole lets the Knob through.
A1_Gear_v2.stl. 24-tooth herringbone gear with a 14 x 14 mm peg; keyed pocket for the Knob in its hub face. Goes on the top end of Cylinder A.
A2_Gear_v2.stl. 24-tooth gear with an 18 x 10 mm peg; wide pocket for the Base's larger post. Goes on the bottom end of Cylinder A.
B1_Gear_v2.stl. 24-tooth gear with a 16 x 12 mm peg; small pocket for the Lid's post. Goes on the top end of Cylinder B.
B2_Gear_v2.stl. 24-tooth gear with a 20 x 8 mm peg; small pocket for the Base's smaller post. Goes on the bottom end of Cylinder B.
Handle_Connector_v2.stl. Keys into Top Gear A through the Lid; the Handle snaps onto its tab.
Handle_v2.stl. The crank; its cup snaps over the Knob. A raised arrow on the grip shows the turning direction.
Remover_Tool_v2_(optional).stl. A plate with three pegs; the Base is set onto it to push the rollers out.

For cleaning the cylinders after embossing.
